name: answerrail-mcp
description: Audit 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt discovery, Google Lighthouse 13.5 ard-schema (ai-catalog.json), and compile Byte-0 Markdown.
author: The Quite Good Project

tools.name: audit_ai_readiness
tools.description: Audits a website URL or domain for AI crawler access, 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt presence, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and Google Lighthouse 13.5 Agentic Browsing (/.well-known/ai-catalog.json ARD 1.0).

tools.name: generate_ai_manifests
tools.description: Compiles ready-to-save /llms.txt documentation index and Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD 1.0) JSON manifests from a live domain.

tools.name: extract_byte0_markdown
tools.description: Strips React/Next.js hydration scripts and DOM bloat from any URL, returning clean Byte-0 GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) with front-loaded Schema.org tables.

tools.name: query_truncation_benchmark
tools.description: Retrieves empirical benchmark telemetry from the 2026 50-Site SaaS & E-Commerce AI Truncation Study.
